name: lodash-bindall-omitted-methodnames-dyson
behavioral_change: lodash 4.0.0 removed the v_old behavior of `_.bindAll` binding all methods when `methodNames` is omitted. In v_new, `_.bindAll(config)` binds nothing; the function name and signature are unchanged and no error is raised.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (dyson) calls `_.bindAll(config)` in `lib/defaults.js` and later registers `config.callback` with Express as a bare function; after the upgrade `this` inside `response.generate` is no longer the config, `service.template` and `service.collection` are `undefined`, and endpoints return `{}`. The six failures are HTTP response body assertions with frames only in `test/dyson.integration.js`; lodash and `bindAll` never appear in the output.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes `_.bindAll(config)` at `lib/defaults.js:49` to `_.bindAll(config, _.functionsIn(config))`.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), section Compatibility Warnings, states that support for binding all methods by default was removed from `_.bindAll`; `_.functionsIn` is documented at https://lodash.com/docs/4.17.21#functionsIn. Tier 2: prose only, no old versus new code; the fix is derived from the two versions' jsdoc.

dyson .registerServices [integration] should respond with a collection (function)
